operational_observations.source_category: Accepted applications plus permanent postal electors
About 95,000 people reported as having voted by post
More than 215,000 people reported as voting before election day
About 120,000 votes cast at pre-polling centres

sources.notes: The election-statistics report tables provide district enrolment and ordinary/declaration formal, informal and total ballot papers. Declaration ballot papers combine pre-poll, postal, absent and other declaration modes and are not split by this adapter.

sources.authority: ABC News, reporting South Australian election figures
sources.notes: Published at 9:10am on election morning. The rounded postal figure is treated as ballots issued because it closely matches the later 94,831 issue total, rather than the 82,213 application total.

sources.authority: Antony Green, based on ECSA data
sources.notes: Later retrospective providing exact final controls for the election-eve rounded figures.
